purpose: Fixed illustrative example for the Look step and the landing page. Three genuine style variations generated from one real reference photo. These are NOT a preview of any user's object and are never regenerated by the app at runtime — selecting a style in the UI only highlights a tile, it does not call a provider.
generatedBy: Mousehold interface worker (Claude Code, claude-opus-5), overnight round 2026-09-24

source.note: Already present in this repository before this work; the same room the bundled 'desk & sofa' sample world is built from. Photographed by the project owner.
source.hostingNote: Temporary signed upload used only to hand the provider a public source_url. Not a publication.

provider.fallbackNote: The capability declares a fallback_chain of [flux-fill, gemini-image]. All three calls returned requested_capability == kontext-edit with ok:true, so no fallback was taken.

cost.basis: cost_usd_estimated returned by the provider on each call, at the static-registry rate. This is an estimate captured at submission, not a confirmed settled charge.
cost.allocation: Interface worker slice, $2.00 of the $10.00 overnight round.
cost.ledgerNote: Deliberately not written to storage/spend-ledger.json — these calls are build-time asset authoring, not an application job.

variants.label: The photo
variants.webNote: No longer shown in the app since 2026-09-26 (the Look step shows only the three looks); the untouched original is kept so the hashes stay verifiable.

variants.label: Cartoon
variants.prompt: Redraw this exact photograph as a cartoon illustration: bold flat blocks of saturated colour, clean confident dark outlines, simplified geometric shapes, bright cheerful even lighting, no photographic texture. Keep the identical room, camera angle and composition, and keep every object exactly where it is — the dark wooden door on the left, the light wooden desk with the open laptop, the framed pictures on the wall, the dark fabric sofa with its cushions, the tiled floor. Change only the rendering style, never the scene.

variants.label: Hand-painted
variants.prompt: Repaint this exact photograph as a warm hand-painted storybook illustration: thick visible oil brush strokes, rich textured pigment, soft golden afternoon light, painterly edges, canvas texture. Keep the identical room, camera angle and composition, and keep every object exactly where it is — the dark wooden door on the left, the light wooden desk with the open laptop, the framed pictures on the wall, the dark fabric sofa with its cushions, the tiled floor. Change only the rendering style, never the scene.

variants.label: Watercolour
variants.prompt: Repaint this exact photograph as a delicate watercolour painting: translucent pigment washes, soft colour bleeds at the edges, visible cold-press paper grain, airy light, bare white paper showing through in the highlights, loose ink line work. Keep the identical room, camera angle and composition, and keep every object exactly where it is — the dark wooden door on the left, the light wooden desk with the open laptop, the framed pictures on the wall, the dark fabric sofa with its cushions, the tiled floor. Change only the rendering style, never the scene.

webCopies.note: The files served by the app are 1120px-wide progressive JPEGs re-encoded from the untouched provider originals in originals/. The originals are kept so the provenance hashes above stay verifiable.
